rulings.reason: The earlier resolve refusal and final metadata refusal use the same copied typo in one sitting; the bar rejects the same cause drawn twice.
rulings.required: In printed act 4 remove the anonymous-cache typo refusal. Describe Bob correcting the copied typo before resolving main and following its manifest URL, then checking correct metadata and receiving the single missing-repository metadata refusal for the original typo. Preserve the trailing doors paragraph.
